subject.title: [Bug]: Mac app replays node connection alerts after Gateway restart

question: Should maintainers sponsor a focused gateway fix that treats an existing pairing reconnect as silent while retaining the initial-pair notification?
rationale: The issue has a protected `maintainer` label and the correct lifecycle predicate depends on maintainer confirmation of the pairing/alert contract.

options.title: Sponsor targeted reconnect suppression
options.body: Confirm the pairing record is the authoritative first-connection signal and implement focused handshake and notification regression coverage.

options.title: Clarify a different alert contract
options.body: Document an intentional reconnect-alert policy if repeated “New node connected” alerts are expected rather than erroneous.

recommendation.title: Sponsor targeted reconnect suppression
recommendation.body: Confirm the pairing record is the authoritative first-connection signal and implement focused handshake and notification regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent routing work and supplied the most detailed report of the intended behavior boundary.
